Did you know that more than 30,000 Hasidic Jews live in Antwerp, Belgium? They settled here for the global diamond trade, which to this day, handles over 90% of all diamonds on the planet!
Join me as I take you on a deep dive into this fascinating community - to learn about their lifestyles, eat their food, and find out how they keep a traditional style in the heart of a modern European city.
